priorityList: Use Metamorphosis on cooldown for single-target encounters.
Activate offensive Trinkets and Potions while Metamorphosis is active.
Cast Void Ray if the Eradicate buff is not active.
Use Voidblade or The Hunt when you reach maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks.
Execute the Reaps sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if you have 4 or more Soul Fragments while Metamorphosis is active.
Cast Pierce the Veil when the Moment of Craving buff is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Use Voidblade if the Moment of Craving buff is active and Collapsing Star stacks are at or near maximum.
Cast Collapsing Star if Predator's Wake is on cooldown and Voidblade is not immediately available.
Execute the Reaps sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if charges are about to cap or the Voidfall Spending proc is active.
Use Vengeful Retreat if the Voidstep buff is active and Collapsing Star stacks are below 30.
Cast Reapers Toll whenever the Voidsurge: Reapers Toll proc is active.
Cast Pierce the Veil if the Voidsurge: Pierce the Veil proc is active or if the Duty Eternal talent is active.
Use Voidblade if Duty Eternal is talented or if Devourer's Bite is active during Metamorphosis.
Use Devour and Consume as fillers when no other abilities are available.
